inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility: 'other tumors meeting staging and DLL3 criteria' explicitly accepts non-SCLC tumors with DLL3 IHC expression. Excludes de novo SCLC and de novo NEPC. Patient's RNA expression alone is insufficient — DLL3 IHC at ≥25% (preferable for stage 1 entry) or ≥1% (stage 2) is the gating biomarker. Inpatient observation required for cycle-1 step-up dosing per CRS-mitigation protocol.
intervention_dosing: 1 mg IV step dose D1, 10 mg D8/D15 cycle 1, then 10 mg q2w (28-day cycles)

biomarker: DLL3 (no IHC threshold required for enrollment)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: trial enrolls SCLC, not osteosarcoma — patient is NOT enrollable here. Included for mechanism-of-action evidence: this is the pivotal trial that drove tarlatamab's FDA accelerated approval and the reason the basket trial NCT06788938 exists. CRS ~50% (mostly grade 1-2; grade ≥3 ~1%); ICANS-like neurologic events ~10%; step-up dosing with inpatient cycle-1 monitoring.
intervention_dosing: 1 mg step dose D1, then 10 mg q2w (target dose)

design: randomized phase 3 (tarlatamab vs investigator's choice chemotherapy)
inclusion_match_notes: Cross-tumor: confirmatory phase-3 in SCLC, not enrollable for an osteosarcoma patient. Included as the highest-quality clinical-efficacy evidence for the tarlatamab mechanism — median OS 13.6 vs 8.3 mo. Establishes the mechanistic basis the board uses when evaluating whether tarlatamab is worth pursuing via the basket trial for a non-SCLC patient.
